properties.name: rmcp 3.1.2 → 3.3.0. The macro now refuses an empty #[tool_router]; the base `impl ReflowService` block (constructors and shared helpers, no #[tool] fn, the twelve slices summed onto it) is empty by design and now says so with `allow_empty` and a comment. No function moved and the served surface is byte-identical — 180 toolsnaps match — so the design holds.
